{"script":"mkdir -p /usr/local/bin 
cat > /usr/local/bin/count <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# count: print number of regular files in DIRECTORY (recursively).
# If there are non-regular files (symlinks, pipes, sockets, devices), print their count on a second line.
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "Usage: count DIRECTORY" >&2
  exit 2
fi
dir="$1"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  echo "0"
  exit 0
fi
regular=$(find "$dir" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
others=$(find "$dir" \( -type l -o -type p -o -type s -o -type b -o -type c \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
printf "%s\n" "$regular"
if [ "$others" -ne 0 ]; then
  printf "others:%s\n" "$others"
fi
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/count
/usr/local/bin/count .
"}
